name: glue_sql_collapse
title: Collapse text and mark it SQL

origin.description: glue_collapse that returns a DBI::SQL string.
origin.details: The collapse rules match glue_collapse. The class is SQL rather than glue.

translation.description: glue_collapse that returns an SQL string, so a later glue_sql will not quote it again.
translation.details: The collapse rules match glue_collapse. The result is an SQL string.
translation.example:
from glue import glue_sql_collapse
print(glue_sql_collapse(["a", "b"], sep=", "))
